verdict: No blocking finding in the inspected static scheduling scope
method: Independent read-only inspection of exact commit contents using git show; subsequent author HEAD changes were excluded. Reviewer did not implement the production change.

inspected_boundaries.finding: The native scheduling predicate accepts only Bool/Integer/Float literals through Group nodes. meta_next counts every original MetaEval in full-item preorder, while the callback map retains only non-native roots. Filtering does not compress original meta ordinals. MetaBlock is not granted native-literal treatment.

definition_expression uses the full-item scan matching Expand meta ordinals. Instantiation separately scans body-only outer roots, retaining each original SourceSite and native classification. Native and evaluated roots both advance the cursor, and completion requires cursor == roots.len(). Original #(N) still enters source-based evaluation when substitution makes its output look like #(42).

Retaining a native root reselects its immutable original SourceSite and compares literal category, complete integer/float text, Boolean value and Group structure. Output merely having literal syntax is insufficient.

The strict native-root branch precedes the ct_types table lookup and checks the inner expression with the original receiving expected type, including mixed native/deferred bodies. Original MetaEval and numeric spelling remain intact. Existing generic integer/float checks retain unused-definition range, precision and dependent-type obligations; the ordinary Types CompileTime path also forwards expected.

An unchanged native MetaEval no longer invalidates closure-site lineage. Actual CT-domain replacement still marks a change. The patch does not manufacture an Original lineage value or relax the original-unreplaced helper capability guard.

The existing parent runtime-instance ledger path remains for functions without deferred roots. The post-materialization scan allows retained native literals but rejects remaining deferred expressions.

excluded: Budget, allocation-capacity accounting and exact-limit acceptance
Receiver-guard behavior and its subsequent repair
Any production delta after the exact implementation commit
Full CT implementation, compiler-wide correctness, formal acceptance gates and performance claims
delivery: This branch adds only this review receipt. Production and tests are unchanged from the reviewed commit. Static findings do not replace root's runtime validation or review of later deltas.
